newsitem.title: USA: TVA Tenn. Watts Bar nuke back to full power.
newsitem.headline: TVA Tenn. Watts Bar nuke back to full power.

text.p: Tennessee Valley Authority (TVA) restored its 1,170 megawatt (MW) Watts Bar nuclear power plant to full output over the weekend after repairing leaking condensor tubes, Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) said.
Production at the Spring City, Tenn., generating station was halved late last week during the repairs.
Meanwhile, another TVA nuclear unit, Browns Ferry 2, was holding at 87 percent of its 1,065 MW capacity after a main feedwater pump trip, NRC said its Monday daily status report.
The neighboring Browns Ferry 3, with identical generating capacity, was operating at full output.
Both Sequoyah nuclear units at Soddy Daisy, Tenn., were running at 100 percent power, NRC said.
Each Sequoyah unit has a rated capacity of 1,148 MW.
